messages:
alice.p: FYI support just dropped a small pile of similar asks about per-tenant usage dashboards. Looks like 5 distinct tickets from different customers this week. Can we cluster these and give a single status back to all requesters?

tom.support: Copying the 5 ticket IDs: TCK-1123, TCK-1137, TCK-1140, TCK-1142, TCK-1148. All ask for per-tenant daily usage graphs + CSV export. They each called it slightly differently.

alice.p: Thanks Tom. Can someone propose a short canonical wording and a tag we can apply so backlog doesn't get fragmented? Also need an owner for follow-up comms.

sam.eng: Proposal: canonical request = "Tenant usage dashboard + CSV export (daily granularity)". Suggest tags: `feature:tenant-usage`, `customer-request`, `cluster:2026-03-tenant-usage`. Owner: product to own scoping, eng to estimate.

maya.sales: +1 on canonical wording. For comms, sales can send a combined status note if we have an ETA or a clear "not planned" decision. Need to surface any blockers (data model changes, infra).

alice.p: OK assigning to me for initial scoping. Sam, can you do a quick feasibility check and a rough cost/effort ballpark? If it's >2 sprints we should consider staged delivery (CSV first, then dashboards).

sam.eng: Quick notes: CSV export is trivial — maybe 2-3 dev days to add an export endpoint + basic paging. Dashboard UI is more design + infra (auth, graphing) — estimate 3-5 sprints depending on scope. Would recommend CSV + minimal chart view as MVP.

alice.p: That sounds reasonable. I'll mark this cluster as "investigate:prod-backlog" and propose MVP = CSV + API + simple embeddable chart. If anyone has strong customer priority pushback tell me.

tom.support: Customers: AcmeCorp (TCK-1123) said it's blocking onboarding for 2 teams, they asked for ETA. BetaCo (TCK-1137) said "nice-to-have". Will flag AcmeCorp as high-touch.

alice.p: Noted. For prioritization: AcmeCorp request = P1 for customer success, others P3. We'll aim to surface an internal RFC by next week with scope and milestones.

sam.eng: For cluster tagging: I can run a small script to tag those tickets and add a short note. Example command I used earlier:```
# tag tickets in bulk
./ticket-cli tag --add "feature:tenant-usage" --cluster "cluster-2026-03-tenant-usage" TCK-1123 TCK-1137 TCK-1140 TCK-1142 TCK-1148
```

ticket-bot: Cluster created: CL-2026-03-07-01 for tenant-usage. Linked tickets: TCK-1123,TCK-1137,TCK-1140,TCK-1142,TCK-1148. Assigned interim owner: alice.p.

maya.sales: Can we include a short templated reply to send to customers? Something like: "Thanks — we're tracking this as a consolidated request for tenant usage exports and dashboards. We're scoping an MVP (CSV export + basic chart) and will share timing by [date]." I can send when you give the date. :thumbsup:

alice.p: Draft reply looks good. I'll have an internal RFC by Mon (1872531200) and will post a customer-facing ETA once eng confirms capacity. For transparency I'll add the RFC link to the cluster ticket.

tom.support: Perfect. I'll update each ticket with link to cluster CL-2026-03-07-01 and the templated note once you share it.

sam.eng: One more engineering note: if we plan for per-tenant graphs long term we should evaluate storage model (aggregates vs raw events). I'll add a tech spike item in the RFC.

alice.p: Good call. Closing action items: (1) alice.p write RFC by Mon, (2) sam.eng quick estimate + spike, (3) tom.support hold customer comms until RFC posted, (4) maya.sales ready to notify AcmeCorp once ETA firm. Will update cluster ticket as we go. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
